create_ema: create exponential moving average updater with configurable decay and optional pmean axis name
create_EmaState: create EmaState dataclass holding exponential moving average state with mu, nu, and decay_product
create_EmaMoments: create EmaMoments dataclass holding latest mean and variance estimates
run_debiased_moments: run debiased_moments method on EmaState to return Adam-style debiased mean and variance
run_update_moments: run update_moments function to update EMA state and return debiased moments given a parameter tree
